finding.expected: Narrow the malformed-family guard to commands that actually attempt to invoke the repository-owned BP-V4 probe launcher/path while continuing to fail closed for malformed forms of that invocation, including malformed quoting after the exact invocation prefix. Add deterministic regressions showing unrelated opaque commands that merely mention the probe filename/path remain opaque/valid, while malformed real probe invocations remain rejected. Do not widen scope, alter the valid probe grammar, worker bounds, Runtime, probe execution semantics, or other BP-V4 authority.
finding.issue: The malformed-probe family guard is a case-insensitive substring search for bp_v4_parallel_probe.py anywhere in the command. That rejects unrelated opaque commands which merely mention the probe filename/path as data or text, even though AC3 and the hard constraint require unrelated unsupported commands to retain existing conservative opaque behavior. For example, an opaque python -c or echo command containing the filename is treated as a malformed BP-V4 probe despite not attempting to invoke the repository-owned probe.
